name: University of Huddersfield

facts.text: The University of Huddersfield's campus is at Queensgate, Huddersfield, HD1 3DH.
Huddersfield offers over 650 courses across five academic schools: Applied Sciences, Arts and Humanities, Business, Education and Law, Computing and Engineering, and Human and Health Sciences.
Notable facilities include the Barbara Hepworth Building and the National Health Innovation Campus, whose buildings are built to the WELL Building Standard.

Huddersfield was ranked 1st in the world for both Reduced Inequalities and No Poverty in the THE Sustainability Impact Ratings 2026, and three quarters of its research was rated world leading or internationally excellent in REF 2021.
The university contributes £300m a year to the local economy and is a major regional employer.

sources.notes: One-page official factsheet, downloaded via curl and read with pypdf. Describes the Home Office credibility interview: 'conducted in English', assesses English ability, no interpreter; 'The interview will be conducted via Skype'. Also lists prompts (not phrased as questions): if returning after a long break explain why and what you did in the gap; who will fund your study and whether the money shown is genuinely available; how you will repay any loan; whether you plan to work in the UK; where you will live and how much it costs; future salary after the course. Advice: practise with family/friends, answers 'well researched and not vague'.

sources.notes: Home Office interview: 'Most students only have one interview. This will be very short over a video link.' The Home Office records the interview and sends a summary to the Entry Clearance Officer, who may require a second, more detailed interview at the Embassy; non-attendance 'may result in your visa application being refused'. Advice: make clear your main purpose is to study and you will not rely on earnings; avoid vague answers. The main hud.ac.uk page does not describe a university-run pre-CAS interview or any platform (CAS Shield not mentioned). Last three topics come from search snippets of this page.
